card.name: Minimum dosing interval before the hours
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a number in phrases like "minimum dosing interval of" and "at least", where a lower limit on hours or age is about to be given.

modes.label: Minimum dosing interval
modes.description: The gap after "minimum dosing interval of" just before the number of hours.
modes.example: with a minimum dosing interval of<< >>6 hours. Infants 29

modes.label: At least / age lower bound
modes.description: The gap after "at least" or an age group, just before a number giving a lower limit of time or age.
modes.example: a second dose may be administered at least<< >>2 hours after the first dose.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning minimum or lowest and suppresses words meaning maximum or not exceeding, so a lower-limit number is expected next.
card.plain: It fires where the label is about to state a lowest allowed value, such as the shortest time between doses.
